description: Introducing the MOTOROLA Pad 60 Neo, a sleek and capable tablet designed to keep up with your everyday needs. Featuring a spacious 11-inch display, this tablet offers an immersive viewing experience whether you are streaming your favourite content, browsing the web, or getting work done on the go. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor, it delivers smooth and responsive performance for multitasking and everyday applications. With 6 GB RAM and 128 GB ROM, you get ample memory for running multiple apps simultaneously and plenty of storage space for your photos, videos, and files. The Wi-Fi Only connectivity ensures you stay seamlessly connected at home or in the office. Dressed in a striking Mabilbu Blue finish, this tablet combines style with functionality, making it a great companion for students, professionals, and casual users alike. Whether you are attending online classes, video calling loved ones, or enjoying digital entertainment, the MOTOROLA Pad 60 Neo is built to deliver a reliable and enjoyable experience every day.
